sentences.text:
After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicant is ready to surrender before the concerned trial court and seek her bail and that her release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another: (2021) 10 SCC 773.
5.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another: (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant for not pressing the other prayers made in the instant application.

6. In view of the above, in case the applicant appears/ surrenders before the concerned trial court within two weeks from today and seeks bail, her release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra) keeping in view that the applicant is a lady and is entitled to the benefit of Section 437 Cr.P.C. Till the aforesaid period, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
7. With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed off.
